citations.assessment: The named report concerns whether two letters written on Shabbat are liable as marking.
The named sage has adjacent statements on allocating portions and causing another person to be punished.
The source explicitly names Yaakov bar bat Yaakov transmitting Ḥunya of Bet Ḥavran, with Yaakov bar Aḥa in an alternate attribution.
